items.title: 24-Year-Old’s $45 Billion Hedge Fund Blows Up Days After Cramer Warned of the Dangers of Margin Trading
items.summary: A 24-year-old wunderkind turned a few hundred million dollars into a $45 billion AI hedge fund in under two years, then watched it all collapse in a single week after a paired trade that seemed bulletproof suddenly moved against him on both sides at once.

items.title: Apple, Amazon, Roblox, Microsoft, Marvell, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Amazon  jumped more than 12% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.  Alphabet  and  Meta Platforms  were both punished by the market after hiking capex this earnings season.  The spending hike is good news for  Marvell Technology  as it helps design Amazon’s artificial-intelligence chips.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Apple, Amazon, SK Hynix, Samsung, Roblox
items.summary: ↗️ SK Hynix (KR:000660), Samsung (KR:005930): Shares of both chipmakers surged over 25% in Asian trading, staging a strong recovery after a turbulent week. Peers Marvell (MRVL), Intel (INTC), Micron (MU), also moved higher.

items.title: Chip Stocks Are Falling: Here Are 2 to Buy on the Dip

Over five years, Marvell Technology has returned 205.9%, which puts current buyers in the position of assessing whether much of the long term value is already reflected in the price. items.title: The Growth That Has To Land For Advanced Micro Devices Stock to Make Sense
items.summary: The sticker shock on AMD’s valuation fades once you look two years out, but the discount hinges on an aggressive growth story that deserves a closer look.

items.title: NVDA Stock: Where Compounding Could Take The Price
items.summary: While the world sees a GPU company, management is building a major business in a market it has never addressed before. The company now has visibility to nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue this year. This shift reframes the growth story from components to full systems.

items.title: One Thing I’m Watching: Retail’s Ill-Timed Sales From Chip Stocks
items.summary: Individual investors are taking some of their chips off the table. Retail traders have piled out of hardware stocks and other artificial-intelligence shares in recent days, according to separate reports from JPMorgan and Vanda Research.
